answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents stake tokens to form a trust graph evaluated via topological cut verifications. Honest nodes audit peer clusters: tightly tangled Sybil cliques mimic a parasitic vine choking the network, yet sparsity cuts easily isolate them. When game-theoretic multi-agent auditing uncovers coordinated dishonest validation, stake slashing imposes superlinear attacker cost. Honest agents remain flexible as a willow, withstanding Byzantine shocks, while penalizing illicit conspirators who lurk in the dark like a sable predator.
